design.name: 连鼓灵·骨笼雷心
design.brief: The Liangu's thunder core in its cage of beast bone, modelled separately (weak spot).
design.turnaround_lead: the Liangu's thunder core in its bone cage
design.turnaround_pose: , standing upright: a cage of pale curved beast ribs and bones bound with bronze bands where they meet, wrapped around a round thunder core painted as a MATTE, flat, opaque magenta-violet sphere with thin flat white zig-zag lines on its surface; MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light, no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the bones (the glow is added later as a game effect); nothing else attached (no ring, no drums)
design.turnaround_digits: Every bone of the cage and the whole core fully inside the frame; the core must be visible between the bones in every view.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
